settings.heading: Care for the details.
settings.body: The right approach starts with the material and the label.

settings.heading: Follow the item, not a general rule.
settings.body:
Consult the garment label or manufacturer instructions before washing, steaming or ironing. Different fabrics and finishes need different handling.

For jewelry and accessories, check the stated material and care instructions before using water or cleaning products. Store pieces separately to help avoid scratches and tangles.

settings.heading: When information is missing.
settings.body: Do not infer material, washability or durability from an image. Our demonstration products may use generated imagery and unverified material concepts. Product descriptions identify these limits.
